theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the #1 eligible and dominant theme (score 1.135), but hurst_tag='mean-revert' explicitly flags it as a mean-reverting mover, crowded=true (z 1.4), and the absolute-trend gate did_NOT_hold_here on China A-shares history. In a mean-revert, one-narrative, gate-helpless tape, the leading theme is the documented failure mode to fade or chase. 'Avoid' is the humblest expression: neither overweight the leader on rank nor fade it on crowding — just stand aside because the only validated edge (drawdown control) doesn't apply here.
